# Cncf Kruize Reviewer

Review Kruize using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Continuous Optimization category. Kruize analyzes your Kubernetes workload metrics and automatically generates right-sizing recommendations for CPU, memory, and GPU resources — reducing costs and improving performance without manual tuning.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
